annotations.title: Compare two versions of a building model

description: WHEN two versions of a house design must be compared: what the client, the architect or another agent changed, and what it changes to the quantities (the basis of a change order). Elements are matched by geometry (wall end points, wall and position of an opening, type and position of an object), never by their index, so deleting one wall does not report every following wall as modified. Returns added, removed and modified elements field by field, and the quantity take-off difference item by item.

avant.description: The original scene (same format as the other CAO tools).

quantites.description: Also compare the quantity take-off, item by item.
